answer: Latent Drift Fingerprinting assigns each identity a rolling behavioural embedding; a fable of past actions is recomputed every epoch from timing, call graphs, and resource patterns. An identity whose embedding shifts beyond a calibrated threshold without matching declared updates is quarantined for that epoch, and its accrued ember rewards are withheld pending revalidation. Sybils must therefore maintain costly long-lived behavioural coherence across every clone, since each new identity needs its own garden of consistent history.
